source_of_truth: GitHub repository metadata, releases, issues, pull requests, and Actions runs are external provider state for ai-org-labs/ai-organization-framework.
permission_boundary: Read-only GitHub metadata access only; no issue, pull request, release, workflow, secret, or repository mutation is allowed.
freshness_boundary: Provider read evidence must record observed_at and be refreshed before release sign-off if the release target changes.
availability_boundary: GitHub and gh CLI authentication must be available for live reads; absence blocks live provider read claims.
approval_boundary: Read access is allowed for this release proof; any write or credential expansion requires explicit human approval.
side_effect_boundary: Read-only gh commands have no intended provider side effects.
not_proven: This resource record does not prove GitHub data semantic correctness, credential safety, billing safety, write safety, or production automation.
